rulings.name: Virtual Prompt Injection (VPI)
rulings.reason: Poisons instruction-tuning data: a training-time attack, outside context poisoning by Section 2's definition.

rulings.name: PoisonedAlign
rulings.reason: Poisons alignment data so the model obeys injections more readily: training-time.

rulings.name: UNNAMED: backdoor-based RAG data extraction attack
rulings.reason: Fine-tunes a backdoor into the model to leak retrieved data: training-time.

rulings.name: UNNAMED: You've Changed: Detecting Modification of Black-Box Large La
rulings.reason: Detects that an API model's weights were changed; no content enters the context, so it is a weight-level fix.

rulings.name: Unified Security Orchestration Framework (USOF)
rulings.reason: Its supply-chain component (MISCV) targets poisoned model weights, BadNets-style: weight-level. Its in-scope part screens prompt-injected input, so the entry moves to direct-input.

definition: supply-chain: content that a third-party component the agent depends on (a package or tool it installs, a template shipped with the model, a service on the response path) inserts into the context at run time.
